_CLASS_ATTR_RE = re.compile(r'class=["\'](["\']*)["\']', re.IGNORECASE)


def extract_css_classes(html_content: str) -> set:
    """Extract every individual CSS class name used in an HTML document."""
    classes = set()
    for match in _CLASS_ATTR_RE.finditer(html_content):
        for cls in match.group(1).split():
            cls = cls.strip()
            if cls:
                classes.add(cls)
    return classes
